scope: 15 source blades and seven distinct fitted bushings; five blades/five bushings per selected fitted configuration, all nine style pairs. No small-face seconds hand. No raw catalog animation or Bench hand change.

timeMapping.formula: T=C+(E(a)-54*a)/54; reader degrees=T*{hour:1/120,minute:1/10,seconds:6}; world delta=faceSign*(reader-reference). C is fresh local civil seconds modulo 12h, a is existing active seconds, E is unchanged accumulated escape degrees.
timeMapping.secondsBehavior: Existing six-beat-per-second prescribed advance, dwell and recoil, not uniform sweep or 1 Hz ticking.
timeMapping.phaseOffsetToGears: faceSign*rate*(C-a)-faceSign*referenceAngle. Load/resume/system-clock/timezone adjustments are illustrative time setting; no physical slip or setting mechanism is asserted.

lifecycle: Same scheduler and gear clock. Explorer assembled focus/reveal/selection/isolation/flip run. Separation holds last hand angles in presentation coordinates until displayed separation zero, then current-time resync. Hidden return also resyncs. Inventory restores static reference; Workshop runs only at completion and Undo restores endpoints; Bench unchanged; dispose restores matrices and clears registrations.

clearance.method: Continuous full-turn boxes/enclosures/annuli only where recorded. Remaining <=10 degree relative-angle samples do not bound intersample interference. Independent hand/gear phases allow illustrative setting adjustments. Invalid originals are not qualified. Whole assembly separation paths not checked.

observations.name: Sustained rendering spans multiple cycles without resource growth
All nine style pairs show known fractional times on both faces
Live hands agree with local civil time within one beat and frame latency
Live browser timezone changes are reflected on the next rendered frame
Delayed frames do not leave fitted hands behind wall time
Every sampled frame obeys inspection/disassembly policy and displayed shaft transforms
Completed Workshop shows current time with all five hands and bushings

limitations: Marker overlaps at all 12 small-dial positions for all three minute styles; authored 10:10 already overlaps the 2 oclock marker.
New relative-angle broad-lance hour/minute interference near effective civil 10:53:38.182.
Central Lance minute/outer-ring overlap already present at reference, plus retained blade/bushing and bushing/shaft fits.
54 remaining nonpenetrating pairs sampled only; invalid originals and full separation paths unqualified.
Unchanged rear-hour margin about 45 nm; 93/137 and 214/217 assumptions and barrel-II boundary unchanged.
Synthetic visibility/Workshop completion; desktop performance only. Device-clock accuracy, not external time calibration.
No push, PR, merge, deployment or publication; release gates remain.
